ai.purpose: RTT/3 engine layer for Quantum Mechanics: triadic-substrate integration, multi-regime simulation hooks, coherence-resonance mapping, and hybrid-canon scaffolding.

engine.description: Integrates Quantum Mechanics into the triadic substrate, enabling multi-regime reasoning, coherence propagation, and hybrid-canon simulation.

mapping.structure: Amplitudes correspond to substrate resonance configurations; superposition reflects overlapping resonance modes.
mapping.behavior: Unitary evolution emerges from stable resonance flow across substrate channels.
mapping.measurement: Measurement corresponds to resonance collapse into stable distinction channels.

constraints: Propagation speed and locality are substrate invariants within regime.

R1.behavior: Primitive amplitude behavior; unstable distinctions; coherence dominates.
R1.notes: Superposition is unconstrained; measurement channels weak.

R2.behavior: Stable operator algebra; measurement structure; predictable evolution.

R3.behavior: QM becomes a limiting case of QFT; excitation grammar takes over.
R3.notes: Amplitude-level coherence yields to excitation-level resonance.

R4.behavior: QM loses meaning; macroscopic regimes dominate.

hooks.name: coherence_resonance_sim
hooks.description: Simulates superposition as resonance patterns across amplitude components.

hooks.name: phase_alignment_sim
hooks.description: Models interference and phase-driven resonance behavior.

hooks.name: decoherence_flow_sim
hooks.description: Simulates environmental coupling and resonance collapse into distinctions.

hooks.name: regime_transition_sim
hooks.description: Simulates breakdown of QM coherence across R1→R2→R3 transitions.

simulation.notes: Simulations operate on resonance patterns and substrate invariants, not on wavefunctions as physical waves.

hybrid_canon.purpose: Enable agentic AIs to reason across quantum, informational, and relativistic modules using shared substrate invariants.
